testcase.name: Scenario: Show and hide an origin axis from its browser menu: mnt/vininas-projects/MCAD-Scenarios/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:243:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Show and hide an origin axis from its browser menu ✔ Given an active part with a visible block is open in the MCAD Software ✔ And the Origin branch is expanded and the X Axis is hidden ✔ When the user right-clicks the X Axis row ✔ Then the row is highlighted and the axis is highlighted in blue in the viewport ✔ And Visibility is unchecked and Auto Resize is checked in the context menu ✔ When the user chooses Visibility and clicks empty viewport space ✔ Then the axis remains visible as a line beside the block ✔ When the user right-clicks the X Axis row again ✔ Then Visibility is checked in the context menu ✔ When the user chooses Visibility again ✔ Then the axis is hidden and the block remains visible
